I was on site yesterday and, as recommended, I swapped the USB port. After the change, the RFID reader is working again. However, this was also the case during the last service visits after performing a reboot.
Please check whether the reader now operates reliably on a permanent basis. During my visit, I noticed that the RFID LED is permanently illuminated (see video and photos).
Is it possible that this is the root cause of the issue? That the reader is constantly active?
BR
Daniel

additional_info.subject: RFID Reader Issue - USB Port Swap
additional_info.body:
To provide additional context to Daniel's message:
Daniel tried a different USB port after he had already swapped both the RFID reader and the USB cable.
Since the swap,
the reader does not work properly
- it only functions briefly after a reboot, and then
does not work for a very long time until the next reboot
.
Based on our analysis, we would like to order and replace the ET200.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Laurenz Stelz
